insights.text: Vuori is uniquely balanced: 45% women's / 38% men's. Alo skews 31% women's, Gymshark 20% men's.
Vuori's earth tone palette (14%) is +8% vs industry avg—reinforcing California lifestyle positioning.
Jogger battle: Vuori (160) vs Lululemon (205). Gap of 45 to close.
Leggings opportunity: Lululemon has 207 vs Vuori's 182. Gap of 25 SKUs.
Neutrals (black/white/gray/navy) = 45% of Vuori's palette. Core basics that drive repeat purchases.
Vuori leads Lululemon in men's: 1550 vs 1286 products. A 21% advantage.
Vuori ranks #3 in shorts with 727 products. Behind Gymshark (1350).
Outerwear depth: Vuori has 537 products vs Lululemon's 680. Key for cooler weather expansion.

alerts.message: On Running has 2x Vuori's catalog size
